calls.video_title: Is TJX Stock an Undervalued Stock to Buy Right Now?
calls.thesis: Reiterated hold: 10-15% overvalued vs DCF even with margin of safety; better opportunities elsewhere, no need to dump.
calls.base_case: Strong ROIC (~26%), accelerating store expansion from 7,000 to 7,500 units.
calls.bull_case: Off-price demand stays strong; expansion compounds shareholder value.
calls.bear_case: Incremental dollar gets better risk/reward elsewhere; overvaluation persists.
